title: University-Industry Entrepreneurship Ecosystem
description: Turning academic knowledge into real-world opportunities for students, entrepreneurs, and SMEs. As Director of the University Business Consulting and involved in Business Incubation and Internship & Career Development, I work at the intersection of university, industry, entrepreneurship, and professional development. The university becomes more than a place of learning, it becomes a platform where students connect with industry, develop digital capabilities, explore entrepreneurial opportunities, and transform ideas into action.
quote: Builds university–industry ecosystems that transform students from knowledge recipients into capable professionals, entrepreneurs, and contributors to sustainable economic development.
